leakage_statistic: strongest observed across measured arms: per-seed max over the base-tier forward/SIPIT attacks, the defense-aware surrogate arm, the white-box-aware arms, and — when present — the adaptive end-to-end (true transform) arm. A measured statistic over the measured arms only — stronger or better-optimized attacks may recover more.
eligibility_conditions: PCA-superiority requires BOTH the bootstrap condition (point estimate > 0 AND bootstrap CI lower > 0 on the paired per-seed differences) AND the all-seeds-positive condition (per-seed paired difference > 0 for EVERY seed). They are separate mechanical checks, recorded separately per candidate; the bootstrap condition alone does not imply improvement on every paired seed.

notes: field wording corrected post-review: the per-seed leakage statistic is the strongest observed attack result across measured arms (earlier drafts mislabeled the white-box-only max as a conservative ceiling); schema name unchanged (llm_attacker.operating_point_selection.v1), the comparison block now carries statistic_label, bootstrap_condition and all_seeds_positive_condition sub-records.

adaptive end-to-end (whitebox-e2e) tier ingested: when the analyzer's whitebox_e2e_seed_rows are present, the adaptive_e2e snap value joins the per-seed max (validated fail-closed like every other arm; NOT_EVALUABLE cells are scored over the remaining measured arms with the exclusion recorded under e2e_tier); schema name unchanged.

access_labels.surrogate_arm: the defense-aware arm fits a PCA surrogate (stand-in) inverse on public calibration; it is NOT a faithful decoder of the true defense transform and its recovery numbers are an approximation, not a certificate
access_labels.whitebox_tier: white-box-aware rows grant the attacker the TRUE defense checkpoint (encoder weights / PCA basis + provenance) — a strictly stronger access condition than the matched matrix. White-box recovery is a stronger-access measurement; it does not constrain black-box recovery of the same wire, nor the reverse
access_labels.whitebox_e2e_tier: adaptive end-to-end rows grant the attacker the TRUE defense checkpoint and optimize each wire's token sequence straight through it — a strictly stronger, adaptive access condition. Adaptive e2e recovery is a stronger-access measurement only: it does not constrain black-box recovery of the same wire, nor the surrogate arm, nor any defense-internals-hidden adversary

pca_leakage_comparison.whitebox_tier: NOT_EVALUABLE: tb-cotrain co-trains the encoder DURING victim finetuning (splitbench interleaves a minimax encoder update every tb_cotrain_interval steps), but only the FINAL co-trained encoder checkpoint is saved. A future capture rig that stores per-update encoder versions (or post-training inference captures) can lift this exclusion.
